comment: No source is published. The distribution switch is off by one against its own labels. The code takes the jack's voltage times 1.2, subtracts 1, and adds the truncated switch value; with nothing patched the jack reads 0V, so the number handed to Distribution::process is the switch position minus one, clamped to 0 at the bottom. The distribution function subtracts 1 again and dispatches 1 to 5 as Cauchy, logistic, hyperbolic, arcsine and exponential, with everything else falling through to a uniform draw. So UNI and CAUCHY both give the uniform shape, LOGIST gives Cauchy, HYPERBCOS gives logistic, ARCSINE gives hyperbolic, EXP gives arcsine and DUST gives exponential. The seven labels are UNI, CAUCHY, LOGIST, HYPERBCOS, ARCSINE, EXP and DUST. Output 0 is configured but has no PortWidget and is never written, so it gets no line and no tag; output 1 is the only jack on the panel. The rate figure of one to twenty thousand a second is 20000 raised to the knob's own 0 to 1 range; the hundred and forty a second at the default half-travel follows from it.
